items.name: akso-tokens
items.title: Akso UI color tokens
items.description: Color tokens checked against WCAG 2.2 AA contrast, for light and dark mode. Installed automatically with every Akso UI component.

items.name: akso-styles
items.title: Akso UI shared styles
items.description: Button and focus ring styles shared by Akso UI components. Installed automatically.

items.name: akso-form
items.title: Akso UI form helpers
items.description: Field context, a shared polite live region for announcements, and a submit marker. Used by Field, Input, Textarea and Form. Installed automatically.

items.name: akso-status
items.title: Akso UI status styles
items.description: Status icons (a different shape for each status) and colors shared by Alert and Toast. Installed automatically.

items.name: akso-locale
items.title: Akso UI default texts
items.description: Default texts of Akso UI components in plain language, in English and Spanish, with AksoLocaleProvider to choose or change them. Installed automatically.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Accessible button built on Base UI. Visible focus ring, 44px targets, and a loading state that keeps focus and is announced by screen readers.
items.docs: Akso UI Button: icon-only buttons need an aria-label. Accessibility notes and test status: https://github.com/jfpanchi/akso-ui/blob/main/ACCESSIBILITY.md

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Accessible modal dialog built on Base UI. Traps focus, closes with Escape, returns focus to the trigger, respects reduced motion and works at 320px wide.
items.docs: Akso UI Dialog: always include a <DialogTitle>. Accessibility notes and test status: https://github.com/jfpanchi/akso-ui/blob/main/ACCESSIBILITY.md

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Label, description and error messages for a form control, linked for screen readers. Shows required fields as text and announces errors as they appear.
items.docs: Akso UI Field: every field needs a FieldLabel; write clear messages with <FieldError match="...">. Accessibility notes and test status: https://github.com/jfpanchi/akso-ui/blob/main/ACCESSIBILITY.md

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Single-line text field for use inside Field. 44px tall, 16px text, visible focus ring and an invalid state that does not rely on color alone.
items.docs: Akso UI Input: use it inside <Field> with a <FieldLabel>, and set type and autoComplete. Accessibility notes and test status: https://github.com/jfpanchi/akso-ui/blob/main/ACCESSIBILITY.md

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Multi-line text field for use inside Field, with the same accessible states as Input.
items.docs: Akso UI Textarea: use it inside <Field> with a <FieldLabel>. Accessibility notes and test status: https://github.com/jfpanchi/akso-ui/blob/main/ACCESSIBILITY.md

items.name: fieldset
items.title: Fieldset
items.description: Groups related fields under a legend that screen readers announce when focus enters the group.
items.docs: Akso UI Fieldset: always include a FieldsetLegend. Accessibility notes and test status: https://github.com/jfpanchi/akso-ui/blob/main/ACCESSIBILITY.md

items.name: form
items.title: Form
items.description: Form that validates its Fields, moves focus to the first error on submit and announces how many fields need attention.
items.docs: Akso UI Form: use it with Field; translate the message with invalidMessage. Accessibility notes and test status: https://github.com/jfpanchi/akso-ui/blob/main/ACCESSIBILITY.md

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Checkbox with its label as one 44px target. Ticked and partly ticked states show a check mark or a dash, not only a color.
items.docs: Akso UI Checkbox: the children are the visible label. Accessibility notes and test status: https://github.com/jfpanchi/akso-ui/blob/main/ACCESSIBILITY.md

items.name: checkbox-group
items.title: Checkbox group
items.description: A group of checkboxes named by a legend that screen readers announce when focus enters the group.
items.docs: Akso UI Checkbox group: always set legend; put Checkbox items with a value inside. Accessibility notes and test status: https://github.com/jfpanchi/akso-ui/blob/main/ACCESSIBILITY.md

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio group
items.description: Radio buttons named by a legend, with arrow-key navigation. The chosen option shows a dot, not only a color.
items.docs: Akso UI Radio group: always set legend; each Radio needs a value and visible text. Accessibility notes and test status: https://github.com/jfpanchi/akso-ui/blob/main/ACCESSIBILITY.md

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: On/off switch for settings that apply at once. 'On' is shown by position, fill and a check mark.
items.docs: Akso UI Switch: the children are the visible label; inside forms sent with a button, prefer Checkbox. Accessibility notes and test status: https://github.com/jfpanchi/akso-ui/blob/main/ACCESSIBILITY.md

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Select with a visible label, keyboard and typeahead support, a high-contrast highlight ring and a check mark on the chosen option.
items.docs: Akso UI Select: always add a SelectLabel; for long searchable lists use a combobox. Accessibility notes and test status: https://github.com/jfpanchi/akso-ui/blob/main/ACCESSIBILITY.md

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert dialog
items.description: Confirmation dialog for actions that cannot be undone. Focus starts on the safe choice; clicking outside does not close it.
items.docs: Akso UI Alert dialog: put AlertDialogCancel first; always add a title and a description. Accessibility notes and test status: https://github.com/jfpanchi/akso-ui/blob/main/ACCESSIBILITY.md

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Notifications that pause on hover and focus, stay until dismissed when they are errors or have an action, and show an icon and a status word for each type.
items.docs: Akso UI Toast: wrap the app in ToastProvider and use useToast(); never put information people need only in a toast. Accessibility notes and test status: https://github.com/jfpanchi/akso-ui/blob/main/ACCESSIBILITY.md

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Message on the page (info, success, warning, error) with an icon shape and a hidden status word for each type. Optional live announcement.
items.docs: Akso UI Alert: set live="polite" only for messages that appear after an action. Accessibility notes and test status: https://github.com/jfpanchi/akso-ui/blob/main/ACCESSIBILITY.md

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Progress bar named by its visible label, with the value also shown as text. The unknown-amount state does not move with reduced motion.
items.docs: Akso UI Progress: always set label. Accessibility notes and test status: https://github.com/jfpanchi/akso-ui/blob/main/ACCESSIBILITY.md

items.name: meter
items.title: Meter
items.description: Meter for a measurement in a known range, named by its visible label and shown as text.
items.docs: Akso UI Meter: always set label; use getAriaValueText for friendly text. Accessibility notes and test status: https://github.com/jfpanchi/akso-ui/blob/main/ACCESSIBILITY.md

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Tabs with one Tab stop, arrow keys and manual activation. The selected tab has a thick underline and bold text, not only a color.
items.docs: Akso UI Tabs: name the TabsList with aria-label when no heading is above it. Accessibility notes and test status: https://github.com/jfpanchi/akso-ui/blob/main/ACCESSIBILITY.md

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Accordion with real headings, aria-expanded, and closed panels that find-in-page can open (hidden=until-found).
items.docs: Akso UI Accordion: set the heading level with level to fit the page outline. Accessibility notes and test status: https://github.com/jfpanchi/akso-ui/blob/main/ACCESSIBILITY.md

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: Show/hide section with aria-expanded and an arrow that shows the state; findable by find-in-page.
items.docs: Akso UI Collapsible: the trigger text says what is inside. Accessibility notes and test status: https://github.com/jfpanchi/akso-ui/blob/main/ACCESSIBILITY.md

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Popover that moves focus inside, closes with Escape and returns focus. Use it for info icons instead of a tooltip.
items.docs: Akso UI Popover: add a PopoverTitle; icon-only triggers need an aria-label. Accessibility notes and test status: https://github.com/jfpanchi/akso-ui/blob/main/ACCESSIBILITY.md

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Visual label for icons on hover and focus. Names icon-only triggers with its text and keeps visible text as the name.
items.docs: Akso UI Tooltip: never put needed information only in a tooltip; wrap the app in TooltipProvider. Accessibility notes and test status: https://github.com/jfpanchi/akso-ui/blob/main/ACCESSIBILITY.md

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu
items.description: Action menu with arrow keys, typeahead and a high-contrast highlight ring; checkbox and radio items show a mark.
items.docs: Akso UI Menu: use it for actions; use links for navigation. Accessibility notes and test status: https://github.com/jfpanchi/akso-ui/blob/main/ACCESSIBILITY.md

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Filterable select with a visible label, announced result counts, a 'no results' message and a high-contrast highlight ring.
items.docs: Akso UI Combobox: always set label; translate emptyText and resultsText. Accessibility notes and test status: https://github.com/jfpanchi/akso-ui/blob/main/ACCESSIBILITY.md

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Slider with a visible label and value, keyboard support, and − / + buttons so dragging is never required (WCAG 2.5.7).
items.docs: Akso UI Slider: always set label; use getValueText for units. Accessibility notes and test status: https://github.com/jfpanchi/akso-ui/blob/main/ACCESSIBILITY.md

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: Panel that slides in from an edge, with a focus trap, Escape, and an always-visible close button so swiping is never required.
items.docs: Akso UI Drawer: always add a DrawerTitle. Accessibility notes and test status: https://github.com/jfpanchi/akso-ui/blob/main/ACCESSIBILITY.md

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation menu
items.description: Site navigation with panels of real links, aria-current for the current page, and keyboard support.
items.docs: Akso UI Navigation menu: label the menu with aria-label when the page has more than one nav; set active on the current page link. Accessibility notes and test status: https://github.com/jfpanchi/akso-ui/blob/main/ACCESSIBILITY.md

items.name: autocomplete
items.title: Autocomplete
items.description: Text field with optional suggestions: free text allowed, visible label, announced suggestion count and a high-contrast highlight ring.
items.docs: Akso UI Autocomplete: always set label; use Combobox when only listed options are valid. Accessibility notes and test status: https://github.com/jfpanchi/akso-ui/blob/main/ACCESSIBILITY.md

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A button that stays on or off, with aria-pressed, a pressed style that does not rely on color, and 44px targets.
items.docs: Akso UI Toggle. Accessibility notes and test status: https://github.com/jfpanchi/akso-ui/blob/main/ACCESSIBILITY.md

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle group
items.description: A named group of toggle buttons with arrow-key navigation, single or multiple selection, and 44px targets.
items.docs: Akso UI Toggle group. Accessibility notes and test status: https://github.com/jfpanchi/akso-ui/blob/main/ACCESSIBILITY.md

items.name: number-field
items.title: Number field
items.description: A number input with − and + buttons, arrow-key steps, min/max, formatting, translated labels and 44px targets. Use it inside Field.
items.docs: Akso UI Number field. Accessibility notes and test status: https://github.com/jfpanchi/akso-ui/blob/main/ACCESSIBILITY.md
